ja231:1.1: Just as when (someone), buying men’s shoes for
ja231:1.2: Ease and use, (so) suffering could be removed,
ja231:1.3: Oppressed by the scorching heat on the feet,
ja231:1.4: They chafe at the feet of that person.
ja231:2.1: So he of bad family, ignoble,
ja231:2.2: Stealing this science and learning of yours,
ja231:2.3: Being consumed by his learning right there,
ja231:2.4: The ignoble one is like a bad shoe.
